description: Portable, complete optimizer-update metrics from the completed GPT-2 Small run with one epoch-equivalent token budget. Training randomly sampled windows; the budget does not imply exact once-through dataset coverage.

coverage.deduplication_rule: Keep the last train event for each update in source-file order. Update 5 is the only duplicate; loss, learning rate, and token count agree, while timing and some runtime diagnostics differ.
coverage.wall_clock_limit: Metrics contain no wall-clock timestamps. The update-index plots cannot locate interruptions or quantify downtime; there are no gaps in unique optimizer-update coverage.

training.throughput_definition: Combined global tokens divided by the sum of measured iteration durations across the deduplicated updates. This excludes evaluation, checkpoint saving, startup and interruptions; it is not end-to-end wall-clock throughput.

validation.protocol: Sampled training-time held-out validation; points are the reported validation events. Not the separate full-file evaluation protocol.

learning_rate_schedule.indexing: Completed update n uses schedule index n-1.
learning_rate_schedule.interpretation: The run completed one epoch-equivalent token budget using randomly sampled windows, early in the configured decay schedule. No causal claim about generation quality follows from this observation.

plots.training_loss: Individual-update train losses, a trailing 100-update arithmetic mean with no padding, and all 19 sampled validation points. The right panel expands the later-update loss scale.
plots.learning_rate: Recorded per-update learning rates on the left. The right panel distinguishes observed training from the unexecuted configured continuation.

exclusions: Raw checkpoint paths and machine identifiers
publication_format: Public CSV files use LF newlines; all numeric field strings are unchanged from the exact source-derived CSV export.
